summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results and disclosing a subsequent agreement to transfer its eyewear business to the business's management team, retaining a minority stake. The registrant, a Belgium-based 3D printing software/services firm, acts as seller. Terms include no price, premium, or stake percentage stated. Board recommendation not disclosed; no named advisors. The transaction expects impairment charges in Q2 2026. The minority retention implies a partial exit. Watch for regulatory filing of material definitive agreement (Form 8-K equivalent) and impairment magnitude. Risk-arb angle centers on management-led transfer valuation and future minority rights.
